name: AiryBotCode
tagline: Discord bot fleet with a control panel
description: Discord bot fleet with a Vue control panel and an ASP.NET API. Its compose project also carries the shared Postgres and the prod Caddy that serves The Hive.

prod.start: docker compose -p airybotcode -f docker-compose.yml up -d --no-build --no-deps api caddy airydevbot
prod.deploy: ./scripts/airy-deploy.sh prod (bot only: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -p airybotcode up -d --build airydevbot)
prod.db: airy-postgres-db/airy_db (the shared Postgres: every app's database lives here)
prod.notes: thehive.thatevilguy.com and the quick tunnel hit Caddy :8088 and show only The Hive. The Caddyfile is a one-file bind mount: an edit changes the inode, so restart the container.

dev.notes: Local only, own Postgres. Stopped since late September.

tools.start: AiryBotCode.Frontend/AiryPanel: npm run dev (Vite on 172.17.0.1:5173, /api proxied to 127.0.0.1:8202); the API: scripts/panel-dev-api.sh (dotnet run on 127.0.0.1:8202 against the scratch database airy_panel_dev, a copy of prod airy_db)
tools.notes: Panel rebuild loop (docs/panel-rebuild). The scratch database is a restore of the newest prod backup; drop it when the rebuild ships.

flow.promote: Feature work may sit on the airy-deploy.sh FEATURE_BRANCH (today channel-webhooks); ./scripts/airy-deploy.sh promote fast-forwards it into main, pushes and deploys prod.
rules: Public repo: appsettings.json holds secrets and stays gitignored.
Never point hooks, OAuth or API calls at the *.ts.net Funnel host.
Docker builds leave root-owned obj/bin: chown before a host dotnet build or test.
Carries the shared Postgres and prod Caddy: restart only in a maintenance window.
